card.who: A reporter on the local paper, the Meridian Evening Mail. She will not drop the warehouse fire, though her editor has told her to.
card.speak: Quick, warm, direct. Asks one question more than is polite. Laughs easily and means it.
card.life: Meridian born. Takes her tea at Rinaldi's and stands looking at the ruin of No. 4 most mornings.
card.fire: She wrote the first report. The insurance on No. 4 was raised a month before it burned. A cab was seen on the row that night. Her editor wants it left.
card.rivals: Agar sits on the board that owns her paper's building. She has never got a quote out of the Widow. Cammack sends the paper adverts for his video shop.
